title: NCAA Regionals Weekend
blurb: Every D-I and D-III regional, where the nationals fields are decided, plus this week's high school championships, with live results and streams in one place.
seo: NCAA Cross Country Regionals Live Results & Streams
desc: Live results and streams for every 2026 NCAA Division I cross country regional (Nov. 13) and Division III regional (Nov. 14), plus the New Jersey Meet of Champions, the New York state meet, Nike Cross Regionals Heartland and Midwest, and this week's other high school state finals.

meets.time: Women 6K 11:00 a.m. MT · Men 10K 12:00 p.m. MT

meets.name: New Jersey NJSIAA Meet of Champions Cross Country
meets.where: Holmdel, NJ · Holmdel Park
meets.why: New Jersey's fastest runners from every group race together at Holmdel. No. 1 Union Catholic's girls, who scored a perfect 15 at last week's Group meet, go for a fifth straight Meet of Champions title, with No. 19 Ridgewood also in the field. Ocean Township's Leah Starkey, the No. 2 girl in the country, ran 16:45 on this course last week. In the boys race, Union Catholic and No. 16 CBA meet again a week after Union Catholic beat CBA for the Non-Public A title, and CBA's Gavin Schmitt won that race in 15:27.

meets.name: Virginia VISAA State Cross Country Championships
meets.where: Earlysville, VA · Panorama Farms
meets.why: The state championship for Virginia's independent schools, Thursday at Panorama Farms.
meets.recap: Division I: Norfolk Academy won the boys title with 99 points over St. Stephen’s and St. Agnes (107) as Bishop Ireton’s Jason Day won in 15:36.4, and The Potomac School beat Collegiate 56-70 for the girls title as Collegiate’s Virginia Harris won in 18:43.6. Division II: North Cross swept both team titles with 39 points each, led by individual champions Finton Chaney (16:04.1) and Kaitlyn Perkins (19:27.7). Division III: Tandem Friends won the boys title (58) behind Hayes Buppert’s 15:41.0, and Trinity Academy Meadow View edged Timberlake Christian 75-79 for the girls title as Walsingham Academy’s Remington Freeman won in 18:58.2.
